transcript.content: Hello, and welcome. I'm Dr. [Name], a psychiatrist. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, I’m here because for the last couple of years, I just feel low all the time. Like, even when I’m at work, or at church, or around people I care about... there’s just this heavy, empty feeling. It really just doesn’t lift.

You mentioned feeling low for the last couple of years — has this low mood been pretty much constant during that time, or have there been periods where you felt notably better, even if just for a few weeks?

It's been pretty much constant. I haven't really had any weeks where I felt notably better. Um, if I think about the exact timing, it's been going on for about two years and four months. That was right around the time I had to stop taking my community-college classes. It was just getting too hard with money, and my work schedule... so I had to drop out. But yeah, ever since then, it's just been this same low feeling without any real break.
Before you stopped taking those college classes about two years ago, did you ever have a period of time — maybe weeks or months — where your mood felt normal or better than it does now?

Um, I'm not really sure. It's honestly kind of hard to remember what normal even felt like before all this. I mean, maybe I did? But I couldn't tell you for sure if there was a specific time where I felt completely okay back then. It's all just kind of a blur now.

Before these two years started, looking back further — say in the years before you dropped out of college — did you ever have stretches of time where your mood felt pretty normal or good, where you weren't feeling this heaviness?

I really just don't remember. I mean, maybe when I was a lot younger? But during high school and when I first started college... I don't have any clear memories of feeling good or normal for a long stretch. When I try to think back to a specific time where I didn't feel this heaviness, I just draw a blank. I really don't know.

When you try to think back to your teenage years or early childhood, before high school even started, do you remember ever feeling happy or having good days that stood out to you — or has it pretty much always felt heavy like this, even way back then?

Um, I guess when I was really little, maybe in elementary school, things felt a bit different. I mean, I don't remember feeling this heavy all the time back then. I remember playing outside and having fun with friends, so I must have been happy sometimes. But it's been so long, and honestly, everything from middle school on just feels... heavy. So, yeah, maybe early childhood was okay, but I can't really say for sure.

Since middle school started feeling heavy for you, have there been any periods — even just a few weeks or a month — where that heavy feeling lifted and you felt notably better before it came back again?

No, not that I can remember. Um, once it started back then, it really just stayed. I don't think I've had any weeks or months where it actually went away or I felt noticeably better. It's just been pretty constant this whole time.
